coupon_receipts_grantor_variant.name: coupon_receipts_grantor_variant
coupon_receipts_grantor_variant.value:
(grantor_type = 'team_member' and by_team_member_id is not null and by_tenant_id is null and by_coupon_grant_id is null)
       or (grantor_type = 'tenant' and by_team_member_id is null and by_tenant_id is not null and by_coupon_grant_id is null)
       or (grantor_type = 'reciprocal' and by_team_member_id is null and by_tenant_id is null and by_coupon_grant_id is not null)

coupon_templates_grantable_gating.name: coupon_templates_grantable_gating
coupon_templates_grantable_gating.value: grantable_by_tenants or (limit_per_granting_tenant is null and reciprocal_benefit_coupon_template_id is null)

coupons_grantable_gating.name: coupons_grantable_gating
coupons_grantable_gating.value: grantable_by_tenants or (limit_per_granting_tenant is null and reciprocal_benefit_coupon_id is null)

cycles_charging_variant.name: cycles_charging_variant
cycles_charging_variant.value:
(charged = 'upfront' and credit_period is null and grace_period is null and dunning_schedule is null)
     or (charged = 'arrears' and credit_period is not null)

invoices_charging_variant.name: invoices_charging_variant
invoices_charging_variant.value:
(charged = 'upfront' and credit_period is null and grace_period is null and dunning_schedule is null)
     or (charged = 'arrears' and credit_period is not null)

meter_overrides_limit_gte_default.name: meter_overrides_limit_gte_default
meter_overrides_limit_gte_default.value: limit_microcredits is null or limit_microcredits >= default_microcredits

plan_meters_limit_gte_default.name: plan_meters_limit_gte_default
plan_meters_limit_gte_default.value: limit_microcredits is null or limit_microcredits >= default_microcredits
